description: This Java source file implements the main activity for an Android application demonstrating various notification styles, support for Android Wear, and user interactions such as replies and actions. It provides methods for generating different types of notifications (BigText, BigPicture, Inbox, Messaging) with advanced features like remote input, action buttons, and back stack management.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main activity demonstrating notification styles and handling user interactions for notifications.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up the UI elements, and configures the notification styles.

methods.name: onItemSelected
methods.description: Handles selection events from the style selection spinner, updating the display accordingly.

methods.name: onNothingSelected
methods.description: Placeholder for spinner selection event when nothing is selected.

methods.name: onClick
methods.description: Responds to user clicks to generate the selected notification style.

methods.name: generateBigTextStyleNotification
methods.description: Builds and displays a BigTextStyle notification with actions and intent handling.

methods.name: generateBigPictureStyleNotification
methods.description: Builds and displays a BigPictureStyle notification supporting inline reply and wearable pages.

methods.name: generateInboxStyleNotification
methods.description: Builds and shows an InboxStyle notification summarizing multiple messages or emails.

methods.name: generateMessagingStyleNotification
methods.description: Builds a MessagingStyle notification suitable for chat or messaging apps, supporting replies.

methods.name: openNotificationSettingsForApp
methods.description: Opens the app's notification settings for enabling or disabling notifications.
